label: BVSS — soft simplex, spike-and-slab
estimand: ATT on the treated, weights shrunk toward the simplex

label: MVBBSC — Martinez & Vives-i-Bastida

note: 8 NUTS factors on 18 pre-periods; its interval spans zero

note: needs point coordinates; supplied as an MDS embedding of the rook graph

label: SpSyDiD — spatial synthetic DiD
